$comment: Seat of the Real Audiencia and the oldest Spanish city in the Indies; chosen over Havana as Spain's colonial capital.
name: Santo Domingo

$comment: Waterfront facing San Juan de Ulúa.
name: Veracruz

$comment: City lies ~7 km up a narrow-mouthed bay; placed between the waterfront and El Morro so it snaps to the coast at map scale.
name: Santiago de Cuba

$comment: Caribbean terminus of the Panama treasure route; Nombre de Dios was abandoned for Portobelo in 1597.
name: Portobelo

$comment: Pearl-fishing port of Río de la Hacha.
name: Río de la Hacha

$comment: On the west shore of the strait into Lake Maracaibo; assumes the lake counts as navigable sea.
name: Maracaibo

$comment: Port of Santiago de León de Caracas, which lies inland over the coastal range.
name: La Guaira

$comment: Port of Margarita island; the island's capital La Asunción lies inland.
name: Pampatar

$comment: Port of Spain on the Gulf of Paria; Trinidad's capital San José de Oruña lay inland.
name: Puerto de España

$comment: Renamed from Cagway in 1660, five years after the English took Jamaica.
name: Port Royal

$comment: English quarter of St Christopher, shared with France until 1713.
name: Old Road

$comment: Seat of the French lieutenant-general of the Isles (de Poincy, d. 1660) on French St Christophe.
name: Basse-Terre (St. Christophe)

$comment: French since 1649 (du Parquet, sold to Cérillac 1657); later St. George's.
name: Fort Royal (Grenada)

$comment: St Croix held by the Knights of Malta for France 1651-1665; site of later Christiansted.
name: Bassin (Ste. Croix)

$comment: Dutch Nieuw Walcheren colony on Tobago (1654-1666), contested with Courland; placed at Rockley Bay.
name: Nieuw Walcheren

$comment: Cayonne harbour; buccaneer base under nominal French governor du Rausset from 1659.
name: Tortuga

$comment: Buccaneer careening and rendezvous anchorage off southern Hispaniola.
name: Île-à-Vache

$comment: Named for the Dutch privateer Abraham Blauvelt, who used the lagoon as a base from the 1630s.
name: Bluefields
